# Theme brief: Web design tab (unbranded project pages)

Used by `/web-design/endyland/`. Tokens: `/web-design/project-theme.css`. Art direction: docs/DESIGN.md, "Web design".
Bright Memphis and Bauhaus: cream `#FFF4E0`, ink `#1B1B1F`, coral `#FF5A4E`, sun `#FFC93C`, blue `#2D5BFF`, mint `#2EC4B6`.
Archivo (wide and heavy) and DM Sans. Chunky ink outlines, hard offset shadows, springy motion.
